label: boot
js: JSON.stringify({ title: document.title, state: game.info().state, kit: typeof Kit, three: typeof THREE })

label: a move and Foxy's answer
js: game.hold(true); game.start({ size: 8, players: 1, who: 'teddy', level: 'normal' }); game.step(0.5); var g = game.G.game; if (g.turn !== 1) for (var k = 0; k < 40 && !(game.info().ready && game.info().turn === 1); k++) game.step(0.25); var m = game.rules.moves(g); game.tap(m[0]); for (var k = 0; k < 40 && !(game.info().ready && game.info().turn === 1); k++) game.step(0.25); var i = game.info(); JSON.stringify({ discs: i.discs, turn: i.turn, ready: i.ready, shownOk: i.shown === i.board })

label: check
js: var c = game.check({ games: 8 }); JSON.stringify({ ok: c.ok, problems: c.problems })

label: check, sabotaged
js: var c = game.check({ games: 8, sabotage: 'nodiag' }); JSON.stringify({ ok: c.ok, problems: c.problems.length })
